parameters.help_en: The UID of the account to back up
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role of the account to back up. This parameter is required when you configure cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role
parameters.help_zh: 基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份时，配置需备份账号的RAM角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

CROSS_ACCOUNT: Cross-account backup is configured by assuming a RAM role.

CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD: Cross-account backup is configured based on a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
CROSS_ACCOUNT：基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD：基于资源目录配置跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful

Message.description_en: The message returned. If the request is successful, \`successful\` is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request is successful.

false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
